overall_safety_summary: The kitchen workspace is clear, but the user is employing an unsafe knife-handling technique by directing the blade towards their opposite hand, which poses a risk of cuts.

hazards.description: The user is directing the knife blade towards their left hand while manipulating ingredients on the cutting board.
hazards.explanation: Directing a sharp knife towards the opposite hand increases the risk of a slip resulting in a laceration.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults may have reduced skin thickness and slower reflexes, making knife slips more likely to cause severe bleeding or injury.
hazards.recommended_action: Keep fingers curled in a protective claw grip and ensure the knife blade is always directed away from the hands and body.

uncertainties: The sharpness of the knife and whether it is the most suitable tool for chopping tomatoes is unclear.
